title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra $500 off + $300 Trade-in Bonus: 256GB $1399, 512GB $1699, 1TB $2149 (Less Trade-in Value) @ Samsung
body:
Deal: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra $500 off + $300 Trade-in Bonus: 256GB $1399, 512GB $1699, 1TB $2149 (Less Trade-in Value) @ Samsung

[batrarobin] How did you calculate the final price as $1104?
[Bargainer4Life] Final price depends on your trade in device value - I used pixel 8 pro to calculate
[batrarobin] Yeah sorry figured out after commenting.
[dosada] minus phone / table / watch trade-in value
Does it have to be any specific table? 😁😁
[muggleblood] 1399 at scorptec without trade-in. Price match at OW for 5% off or at JB and buy them through discounted gift card.
[Circly] This is still cheaper but I guess you keep your old device.
[IndianWarrior] How much is the penalty if we are not able to send them the trade in phone?
[pyramid] They block amount of trading value on your card….so if you don't send them device then your card will be charged..
[sunyuanxin] If I choose a $20 Apple Watch as my trade-in device, will only $20 be charged to my credit card, while I can still receive the $300 Trade-in Bonus?
[RocketFish] That was the case for the S21 when I did it years ago and I believe it was changed for the S22 onwards.
[jleang] @RocketFish: As in they charge you for the bonus now as well?
[IndianWarrior] Can anyone confirm this? Will I get $300 trade in bonus even for $20 watch?
[Bargainer4Life] @IndianWarrior: Yes, if the watch you're trading in is in the list, you should be eligible
[OZBsince2018] Yes, $20 plus device non-return fee of $30 or $60 will be charged to your card. You can keep the $300 bonus trade in.
[joseph78] @OZBsince2018: You should use a reloadable visa or Mastercard. That way they don’t charge anything extra apart from the initial charge
[OZBsince2018] @joseph78: I wouldn’t do that for $30/60 only, as this can be termed as fraud as this is in line with their terms and conditions of the trade.
[PsyWulf] That trade-in bonus barely makes it on par with retail and selling the old phone yourself
[Tony555] Totally agree. If I trade my S22 Ultra, it makes the total $1184. OfficeWorks will price beat Scorptec to make the price $1329. That means I am getting $145 for my S22 Ultra.
[A 1] HODL for preorder deals on S27 Jan/Feb 2027, not likely to be as good as prior years though obviously :-/
[Zalur] Looks mediocre after the phat pixel 9 pro deal that amaysim dropped today
[Thalminator] After using Samsung for years and a brief bit using Apple, and currently on Pixel 10P, I can confidently say that its a shit experience.
I got it for half price and im still disappointed lol the things got so many bugs its unreal
[Circly] Pixel is quite avg, especially battery life.
[RandomDealHunter] Have the Pixel 8 pro, still in as new condition. Bought it for $499 - which was awesome but it has left me wanting. Not the best experience, far from it tbh. On iPhones now.
[jimojr] Plus you can get an extra 10% off with a Samsung Royalty Voucher through chat.
[jimojr] Discount code. You can ask for any code, just tell them what you’re planning to buy. Last time, they gave me a 40% off code for a refrigerator.
[Melbourne Mama] My s26 ultra from harvey norman optus deal is still in the box. Tempted to get the Amaysim deal and sell the s26 on fb.
[jimojr] That was the best deal for the S26 Ultra, I paid just $966 and got 4 months of free mobile service.
[Brisbane1] I guess flop series 😔 not selling as much as S25
